name: BH
fix_description: Function 0x4e290832 uses balanceOf checks on the pair contract to determine token value/rewards. Attacker manipulates pair balances via Upgrade() function calls (which move USDT in/out of the contract without proper price validation), then calls 0x4e290832 to extract tokens at inflated value. Fix: use TWAP oracle instead of instantaneous balanceOf for price determination.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC uses a long multi-stage attack chain with several nested flash loans, cross-protocol callbacks, repeated protocol-specific function abuse on an unverified contract, liquidity manipulation, and iterative liquidity removal. Writing it would require substantial reverse engineering of custom contract logic and state effects, well beyond a straightforward auditor pattern match.
